    "coverage_note": "all 20 deliberation-set names present in the packet; every one carries a universe_row and at least 2 nomination reasons",
    "canon_status": "HAND-TRANSCRIBED, UNGROUNDED — no lock, no sealed extract, citations not re-verifiable (see PROVENANCE). Structure reads below are mechanical field reads, not canon-cited claims.",

    "gap_filter": "NOT_SERVED",
    "trend_filter": "ma_20/ma_50/ma_100/ma_200 stack order, SERVED",
    "sizing_shape": "atr_14d + bracket.risk_pct where bracket.valid=true (8 of 20 names)",
    "exit_philosophy": "N/A this round",
    "bracket_ruling": "PM RULING R1 honoured: bracket.valid=false reported as context on 12 of 20 names, never used to downgrade/veto/filter.",
    "verdict_legend": {
      "CONFIRMED_STRUCTURE": "structure_shift ABOVE_STRUCTURE or BULLISH_BOS AND MA stack ordered",
      "RANGE_BOUND": "structure_shift RANGE and/or choch_state BEARISH and/or flat ma_20/ma_50",
      "BROKEN_STRUCTURE": "price below ma_50 or ma_200, or ma_200 above shorter averages",
      "DIVERGENT_FROM_NOMINATORS": "structural facts contradict a load-bearing nomination claim",
      "DATA_THIN": "3+ lens slots '--' and/or 3+ structure fields null"
    },
    "seat_level_findings": [
      "runner_setup/premove_setup FALSE on all 20 names; not one M15/M18 tag fires. Leg-counts (UMC 3/3, CVS 2/3) are context only.",
      "lens tiering orthogonal to seat count: lens_positive DB/CVS/EQT/CVX 4, WELL/UMC/OKE 3, AAPL/KHC/ADM 2, CNH/LNG/GEN/SLB/BOX/T/PBR 1, DE/CTVA/KVYO 0. DE (three nominators, conviction 4 unanimous) carries ZERO strong lenses.",

      "vcp_tightness_pct = current_range_pct_5d / base_range_pct, HIGHER = LESS contraction. PBR 100.0, SLB 78.9, ADM 71.2, BOX 69.5, AAPL 68.3, T 26.1 (only genuine contraction, uncited).",
      "up_bar_vol_ratio <1.0 on PBR 0.80, UMC 0.84, DB 0.85, GEN 0.96, SLB 0.97."
    ]
  },
  "structure_reads": [full 20-ticker array committed verbatim to detect-lens.json at this same run — see that file for the complete structure_shift/choch_state/bracket_valid/structural_verdict/notes/disagreements_with_nominators detail per ticker (WELL, CNH, DE, AAPL, LNG, DB, CVS, GEN, KHC, SLB, EQT, CTVA, ADM, CVX, BOX, KVYO, T, UMC, OKE, PBR)],
